verdict.rationale: Gitea ships built-in CI/CD through Gitea Actions, which is GitHub Actions-compatible and lets workflows reuse existing Actions. That implies workflow runs can be viewed within Gitea. However, nothing in the evidence describes an organization-wide or instance-wide view that aggregates runs across repositories. Missing for 10: a documented centralized org-level dashboard of workflow runs, cross-repo run status, filtering and history, and hands-on corroboration of such visibility.
